auditor.name: Jain Saraogi And Co
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter paragraphs: (i) Change of name and shifting of registered office not completed due to non-filing of statutory forms; (ii) Unclaimed dividend of Rs 1.42 Lakh not transferred to IEPF; (iii) Alteration of authorised share capital not given effect due to non-filing with ROC; (iv) Speculative transactions not connected with principal business, net impact not material; (v) Write-back of liabilities Rs 233.84 Lacs and write-off of assets Rs 35.16 Lacs in FY 2024-25 and disposal of assets held for sale in current year; (vi) Non-satisfaction of charges in ROC for ICICI Bank despite squared off dues; (vii) Borrowings exceeded Section 180(1)(c) limits without prior shareholders' approval, subsequently ratified; (viii) Loans granted exceeding Section 186(2) limits without prior shareholders' approval, subsequently ratified.

key_risks: Non-compliance with statutory filings for name change and registered office shift
Unclaimed dividend not transferred to IEPF
Authorised share capital increase not reflected in MCA records
Write-back of liabilities and write-off of assets
Charges not satisfied in ROC records
Borrowings and loans exceeding statutory limits without prior approval
